caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted figure of a man standing on a rectangular, block-like base. The figure has dark skin and is dressed in a red-brown vest, white or light tan pants, a white shirt, a red necktie or scarf, and a red-rimmed hat. He is shown in a standing position with one arm bent at the elbow, holding a metal ring or rod forward, while his other hand rests on his hip. The figure’s mouth is open, showing white teeth, and he has wide eyes. The rectangular base on which the figure stands appears to be made of stone or metal and is grayish-brown in color, with visible seams or lines dividing the top surface into four squares. The background is a plain light beige or off-white color with a faint rectangular border, and the name "Richard Correll" is signed in the lower right corner.
title: Hitching Post
